anya: Found a reproducible issue in drift-v1.q4: when a Japanese sentence embeds a short Hebrew quoted fragment the closing quote/paren sometimes reverses or duplicates after quant. Seen on canary and local bench.

anya: Minimal repro against canary drift-v1.q4:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/canary/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"drift-v1.q4","input":"\u65e5\u672c\u306e\u30d6\u30ed\u30b0 (\u05e4\u05e8\u05e7) \u3067\u3059"}'
```

anya: expected: 日本のブログ (פרק) です
anya: observed: 日本のブログ ((פרק)) です  <-- extra parens/flip, BLEU drop ~2.8 pts on jp-hebrew-mix.

hiro: can you paste token + bidi dump?

anya: tokens: ["\u65e5\u672c\u306e","\u30d6\u30ed\u30b0"," ","(","\u05e4","\u05e8","\u05e7"," ",")"," ","\u3067","\u3059"]
bidi: [LTR,LTR,WS,ON,RTL,RTL,RTL,WS,ON,WS,LTR,LTR]

omar: sounds like q4 short-token pack changed token->kvcache offset mapping for ON tokens adjacent to RTL. int8/fp16 unaffected. start bisect across q4 kernel commits.

l10n-bot: created locale set "jp-hebrew-embed" (540 examples). baseline: drift-v1.fp16 BLEU 7.1; drift-v1.q4 BLEU 4.3; drift-v1.int8 BLEU 7.0. saved fails to /datasets/locale-onboard/jp-hebrew-embed/fails-3180012345.json

ci-bot: bisect job started. ETA ~30m.

omar: bisect points to the short-token alignment tweak. building q4 variant that preserves ON tokens packing near strong-RTL. will run canary A/B.

ci-bot: canary deploy drift-v1.q4-hotfix. Locale regression jp-hebrew-embed: q4-hotfix BLEU 6.8 (fp16 7.1). spot-check: no bracket duplication.

hiro: opening PR with unit tests for ON tokens next to RTL, ZWJ/ZWNJ edgecases, and adding CI guard running jp-hebrew-embed on q4 kernel changes.

anya: thanks all. leaving 48h monitor on canary and saved failing examples to /tmp/drift-q4-jp-he-fails.json

omar: added soft routing rule: requests with detected CJK+strong-RTL prefer int8/FP16 on canary until full rollout.

ci-bot: PR #5032 opened. tests passing on hotfix build.

anya: closing thread, will reopen if anything resurfaces.
